chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Abdillah ibn Sinan, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
One who recites Surah Al-Ahzab extensively will be on the Day of Resurrection in the neighborhood of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) and his wives.
Then he said: Surah Al-Ahzab contains the disgraces of men and women from Quraish and others.
O Ibn Sinan! Indeed, Surah Al-Ahzab exposed the women of Quraish among the Arabs.
And it was longer than Surah Al-Baqarah, but they shortened it and altered it.

key_terms.السُّورَةِ الْأَحْزَابِ: Surah Al-Ahzab (The Confederates), the 33rd chapter of the Quran

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah Al-Ahzab extensively according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Saduq emphasizes the spiritual reward of frequent recitation of Surah Al-Ahzab, linking it to intercessory proximity with the Prophet and his wives. It uniquely highlights the Surah's role in exposing the moral failings of Quraish, particularly the women, and asserts a textual variant where it was originally longer than Surah Al-Baqarah before being abridged. This reflects the Shia scholarly interest in the specific virtues of this Surah and its historical textual integrity.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Abdillah b. Sinan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who recites Surah Ahzaab extensively would remain in the neighborhood of Muhammad (s.a.w) and his wives.
Some men and women of Quraish and non-Quraish are disgraced in Surah Ahzaab.
O Ibne Sinaan! It is this Surah that exposed some women of Quraish.”
